labProjects.title: Vision-Based Interaction and Eye Tracking
labProjects.description: Turning ordinary webcams into gaze-sensing instruments. We build landmark-detection datasets and blink and iris algorithms, then apply the resulting low-cost pipelines to concussion screening, the study of medieval manuscripts, and brain-vision coordination.
publications: Investigating Brain–Vision Coordination Using Camera-Based Eye Tracking
Using Eye-Tracking and Data Visualization to Enhance the Study of Medieval Manuscripts
A Blink Detection Algorithm for Eye-Tracking Applications Based on Facial Geometry
An Eye-Tracking Solution Using Consumer Grade Webcams for Potential Concussion Diagnosis and Evaluation
Face Mask Detection using Mediapipe Facemesh
A Landmark Detection and Iris Prediction Dataset for Gaze Tracking Research
Comparative Analysis of RGB-based Eye-Tracking for Large-Scale Human-Machine Applications

labProjects.title: Large Language Model Behavior and Provenance
labProjects.description: Characterizing what language models actually do, and where their text comes from. Work spans strategic behavior in game-theoretic settings, model fingerprinting and de-attribution, ensembles of small models, and the role written specifications play in LLM-assisted coding.
publications: Strategic Behavior in Large Language Models: A Dataset of Game-Theoretic Interactions
Who Wrote This? Fingerprinting Large Language Models and Model Families
Can Small-Model Ensembles Compete with Larger LLMs? A Performance Evaluation Study
An Open Platform for Studying LLM Behavior in Game-Theoretic Scenarios
A Modular MCP-Based Raspberry Pi Control System with Graphical User Interface Control and Testing
LLM De-Attribution: Removing Model-Specific Signatures from Generated Text
Do Requirements Still Matter? Measuring the Impact of Specifications on LLM-Based Code Generation
Preserving Requirements-Driven Development in the Age of AI: an Empirical Evaluation of the Impact of Software Specifications in LLM-Assisted Coding

labProjects.title: Computing Education and Teaching Analytics
labProjects.description: Studying how AI and data are changing the way computing is taught. Projects benchmark LLM-generated course material, measure adoption of collaborative live-coding tools, and analyze student evaluations of teaching at scale — from sentiment buried in public reviews to the factors that drive response behavior.
publications: Analyzing Student Adoption of a Collaborative Live Coding Software in a Programming Course
Benchmarking LLMs for Content Expansion: Measuring Novelty in Iterative Course Outline Generation
Evaluating Output Novelty in Iterative Prompting in Educational Content Generation
From Angry Reviews to Classroom Success: Using LLMs to Synthesize RateMyProfessors.com Data
A UTAUT-based analysis of the Adoption Factors of Student Evaluations of Teaching
Teaching Evaluations: Using Big Data Visualization to Explore Challenges and Opportunities

labProjects.title: User Experience, Usability and Adoption
labProjects.description: Studying how people perceive, learn, and decide to adopt technology — and redesigning it when they cannot. Work covers knowledge-attitude-behavior modeling and its visualization, security perceptions of conversational-AI memory, adoption criteria for mental-health and scholarly-communication tools, tactile materials that make networking concepts accessible to visually impaired students, and the psychological effects of generative AI on creative work.
publications: Visualizing the Dynamics of the KAB Model with Sankey Diagrams
Tactile Network Topologies: Facilitating Inclusive Learning for Visually Impaired Students in Computer Networking Education
Analysis of the Content of ChatGPT’s Memory: Types of Information, Security Implications, and User Perception
User Awareness of Cybersecurity Risks with ChatGPT's New “Memory" Feature: A Knowledge-Attitude-Behavior Analysis
Patient and Therapist Adoption Criteria for Mental Health Applications
Analyzing the Potential User Adoption of Video Podcasts for Scholarly Research Dissemination
Generative Artificial Intelligence and the Emergence of Creative Displacement Anxiety

labProjects.title: Auction Behavior Analysis
labProjects.description: Mining an extensive auction dataset for how people actually bid, and building the entity-resolution machinery needed to make that data usable. BrandNERD contributes a large brand dataset and analysis pipeline for resolving messy references, paired with a crowdsourced approach for validating the hard cases at scale.
publications: Analyzing Human Dynamics through an Extensive Auction Dataset
BrandNERD - An Extensive Brand Dataset and Analysis Pipeline for Named Entity Resolution
A Crowdsourced Approach for Named Entity Resolution

labProjects.title: Process Analysis and Optimization
labProjects.description: Modeling how real-world processes actually run, then improving them. We look at where constraints, sequencing, and resource use interact, and apply constraint-based methods to find the efficiency that is genuinely available — current work optimizes route-aware container loading under stack load propagation, so packing decisions hold up across an entire delivery route rather than only at the depot.
publications: A Route-Aware Carbon Efficient Container Loading Method with Stack Load Propagation Constraints
